title: Find it or develop it

paper.title: Implicit theories of interest: Finding your passion or developing it?

thesis: “Find your passion” is a fixed theory of interest. It makes you drop the side project the week it gets hard. Develop it instead.
rule: This week, when the side project gets dull or hard, treat that as the development process. Not as evidence you found the wrong passion. Finish the session anyway.

scenes.caption: I had a side project I was sure was the one.
Tuesday it felt like a calling. Thursday it felt like homework.
Do you find an interest, or develop it?

scenes.quote: Urging people to find their passion may lead them to put all their eggs in one basket but then to drop that basket when it becomes difficult to carry.

scenes.note: Mismatching article got less interest under find-your-passion.
Fixed theory expects boundless motivation and little friction.
